post_create_reconciliation.purpose: Detect and repair exactly one missing initializer group without weakening the approved create-only 5+3 provider split.
post_create_reconciliation.trigger: After both create-only provider rules have had an opportunity to reach terminal provider state and before Form 2, go-live, or Billing activity.
eligibility: the Deal is a clearly labeled disposable ZZZ SYNTHETIC record
the Deal still satisfies the exact DEAL_INITIALIZATION entry criteria
a fresh authoritative Deal read covers the eight initializer API names, with a missing value represented only by an absent key or null
the current provider-rule identities and field-update definitions independently match this contract
no downstream Form 2, go-live, paid acceptance, Billing, or terminal test state exists

group_classification.exact: Every field in the bound provider rule is present and strictly equals its contracted default.
group_classification.repairable_missing: At least one field is absent or null, and every present field strictly equals its contracted default. An empty string or any other non-default value is a conflict.
group_classification.conflict: Any present field differs from its contracted default, the authoritative read cannot classify all eight API names, the read is ambiguous, or eligibility is not proven.

repair_write_contract: derive the write only from the field_updates of the one bound missing provider rule
write the complete missing group and no field from the already exact group
fresh-read and reclassify both groups immediately before the one bounded write
do not retry an ambiguous or failed write automatically
independently read all eight fields back and require both groups to be exact before reporting convergence
block and preserve coarse reconciliation-required evidence on any conflict, drift, ambiguity, or readback mismatch
prohibited_effects: changing the create-only trigger or the approved 5+3 split
repairing both groups in one operation
mutating Stage, Form 2 state, go-live state, test timing, paid acceptance, Billing, Zoho Sign, SMS, or customer communication
running against a real customer or prospect

terminal_report_handoff.timeout_and_body_bound: single end-to-end timeout of at most 5000 ms through response-body completion; application/json only; response body at most 4096 bytes
terminal_report_handoff.replay: the consumer atomically claims pending or reclaims only a processing report_claim pre-write row by OPERATION_VERSION; after exact report_write_started readback, processing or reconciliation_required never causes a second CRM write and converges only through exact Deal readback
terminal_report_handoff.terminal_transition: completion and containment compare expected ROWID, STATUS, LAST_OUTCOME, and OPERATION_VERSION, increment the version, and require exact readback; one bounded retry accepts only cursor advancement with unchanged status/outcome, never a semantic conflict; after observing the operation cursor, every transition to completed and every completed replay fresh-reads the authoritative Deal account, deployment/configuration binding, and exact patch; mismatch or unavailable readback CAS-keeps or demotes reconciliation, and stale containment that observes a winning completion gets one fresh read plus at most one repair CAS
terminal_report_handoff.deal_status_boundary: only an unreviewed Live Test_Status may receive a differing terminal patch to Completed; Completed is exact-replay-only, and Failed, Rolled Back, reviewed, or accepted evidence is moved to reconciliation_required without an automatic overwrite
terminal_report_handoff.success_readback: HTTP 200 with report_summary_readback_confirmed plus CRMBillingOperations STATUS completed and LAST_OUTCOME report_summary_readback_confirmed
terminal_report_handoff.readiness_gate: deployment REPORT_RECONCILIATION_STATUS remains Pending until exact Analytics evidence and the completed CRM operation are read back
